content.comment_body: Hello! I’m new to [product_name], and I’m currently experimenting with a [article_no]. Has anyone had any success with a HMI design tool that can connect using the [product_name] cable? I’ve found some examples, like Reliance 4, which can connect to a [article_no] through Ethernet, but I haven’t found a solution that works over the [product_name] cable or any alternative method for the [article_no] version. I’d welcome any suggestions or advice. My goal is to make a basic HMI with four switches mapping to inputs and four corresponding lights to show outputs. I’ve already built this with basic components, but now I’d like to create a more standard HMI for a control room setup. Since I’m new at this, please feel free to provide detailed advice in your replies. Thank you,
Hello [user_name], Have you come across the text display (TDE) operator device from [product_name] itself? It’s straightforward and probably sufficient for your needs. order number: [article_no]

[user_name], Thank you for your reply. I’m aware of the TDE device, but I’m hoping to find something software-based to run on my PC, which would let me customize the HMI further if needed. Your suggestion did spark another idea – maybe to connect an older [product_name] version with an HMI, I should look at the port used by the TDE device instead of the programming port.

analysis.insight_summary: Users with [product_name] [article_no] face difficulty finding flexible, PC-based HMI design solutions due to limited connectivity—specifically the absence of Ethernet in older models. Many third-party HMI tools require Ethernet, so they aren't compatible. While [company_name] provides a dedicated hardware operator device, this doesn't meet user needs for a customizable, software-based HMI interface over non-Ethernet connections.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks a software HMI design tool compatible with [product_name] [article_no] that uses a direct [product_name] cable, aiming for easy customization and PC-based interface creation.
